_comment: Lines for who you were before the fall (flag origin_<id>) and for a run that remembers an earlier ending (flag echo, echo_<ending>).

lines.text: Those seeds in your coat. Glowbeet, but not ours. Older. Could I have one? Not to plant. For the moss to look at.
You looked at the children's throats when you thought nobody saw. Good. Keep doing it. Tell me what you find, not them.
The moss leans toward you. It does that with people it knows. It doesn't know you. ... Does it?
